scope: Causal current-state window export correction and fixed-reader coverage comparison; no WM/planning/upload.
held_physical_definition: UNCHANGED: bilateral force-bearing descendant finger contacts >0.01N AND no external force-bearing contact at anchor t.
history_semantics: Exactly [t-3,t-2,t-1,t]. Earlier labels/commands may differ. Require target visible in at least one camera in all4frames; no future input. Future motion only verifies physical labels.
replay: Reconstruct original complete initial scene from immutable native config+original seed+all block poses+drawer state. Replay original recorded motor actions including settling; verify complete saved scene+robot checkpoint at frame24. Never inject intermediate GT state. Save complete actual public frames.

tolerances_preexecution.exact_recovery_requires: All numeric<=1e-9, identical event sequences, all saved RGB and visible mask arrays bitwise equal. Otherwise within tolerance marked NEW_REPLAY, never original-frame restoration.
tolerances_preexecution.failure: Outside tolerance stops continuation for evidence review; preserve outputs, do not relax tolerance or resample root.

sample_export.hard: First causal anchor in descend_named_block with closed command, bilateral finger force, external support, TCP<75mm, valid current labels and4framevisibility.
sample_export.ordinary: Last causal anchor in descend_named_block with open command, no force-bearing robot contact, external support, TCP<75mm, valid current labels and4framevisibility. Same root/trajectory; no model selection.
sample_export.positive: Last held anchor in verify_stable_completion, valid current labels and4framevisibility, plus full-motion co-follow verified>=20mm andrelative drift<=15mm.
sample_export.root_pairing: Include root in training treatment/control only when hard,ordinary,positive all valid. Retain missing roots/failures; no substitute or outcome-driven reset.
sample_export.supervision: New windows target held/in and drawer-open only, current-frame labels. Original900+73window supervision unchanged from joint balanced_loss, including original in/open and real held.

comparison.pool: Original900 +73 + (ordinary OR hard)one/root +positive one/root; full12=>997windows. Same append-index mapping byroot.
comparison.loss: Same fixed previous balanced-loss weights for held/in/open.
comparison.sampling: Seeded shuffled stream over identical pool sizes; save and reuse exact index arrays across arms.
comparison.selection: Unchanged raw per-domain/predicate gates then excess then domain/root/class macroBCE, earlier tie. Tune domains oldC180,newhistoricalC37,freshC3roots.
comparison.calibration: Same tau grid and joint criteria, domains oldC120,newhistoricalC37,freshC3otherroots. No new dev/test roots in train.
comparison.fresh_dev_conditions: Export hard,ordinary,positive at each new C root; evaluate target held/in/open, true-held recall and known/UNKNOWN. No future frames or success input.
comparison.confounds: Hard vsordinary differs in closing command/aperture and contact appearance. It tests difficult-state coverage, not isolated support causality. Same-root pose, colour, drawer and positive supervision held fixed.
comparison.success_interpretation: Do not equate passing tiny sample gates with proof. Report paired seed/root differences and oldC/newC recall,in/open,unknown regressions.
comparison.conditional_small_acceptance: Only if at least2/3seeds show fewer freshC hard FPs with no trueheld-FN increase and no historicalC in/open error increase; freeze both arms weights/thresholds before6fresh nativeDroots with same3conditions, once. No acceptance-driven repair.
